description: Occluded segments at 11 viewpoints, one image each. distance: image distance from the occluded-line pixels to the nearest visible evidence. facing: the four conditions for dividing the occluded length by the facing direction of the rock surface, per viewpoint, and where they are all met the division itself (split). retained_length: share of the trace length facing the camera that is visible and not unclear, for the 10 images of every viewpoint of the multi-illumination aerial set that meets the conditions.
paper_items: main text Section 4.2: 28.6% of the in-frame length occluded, 85.7% of it on rock facing away from the camera, 5.4% of the length facing the camera occluded (viewpoint a0062, about 3 degrees between line of sight and rock-surface normal)
supplement S4: position and facing direction of the occluded segments (distance table; fault-trace shares; conditions; b, o_f and o_f with equal weight)
supplement S4: apparent width, gaps and the trace length retained in the labels, last paragraph

units.weight_px: image length, pixels (lengths of the label program)
units.b: occluded length on rock facing away from the camera / occluded length
units.o_f: occluded length facing the camera / (that length + visible length)
units.theta_deg: angle between the line of sight and the rock-surface normal at the camera target, degrees
units.joint_set_direction_deg: mean direction of the joint set(s) of the traces as written in the scene configuration (30 or 120 degrees, anticlockwise from east)

conditions.C1: at least 99% of the samples lie within 0.1 mm of the plane of their triangle of the uncut rock surface
conditions.C2: at least 95% of the visible length faces the camera (dot product of triangle normal and direction to the camera > 0)
conditions.C3: occluded / in-frame length reproduced from the depth map within 2 percentage points of report.json
conditions.C4: at least 99% of the in-frame length facing away from the camera is occluded

notes: The samples lie on the centreline of the groove mouth; where the triangle normals inside a joint groove vary strongly, per-triangle normals do not represent the facing direction at the scale of the mouth. This is why C2 or C4 is not met at most viewpoints, and why the division is reported only where all four conditions are met.
The occluded-line layer of a frame with a fault also holds the occluded fault traces (distance.fault_trace_in_occluded_line).
The visible evidence leaves 2-4 px empty where visible and occluded parts of a trace meet, because the label layers remove the centreline pixels around such transitions.
The groups of similar strike are formed per viewpoint by cutting the traces, sorted by strike azimuth, at the two largest circular gaps; a viewpoint with two traces therefore always has two groups.

C4.note: no in-frame sample faces away from the camera: the condition has no object and counts as met

retained_length.definition: L_f = visible length of report.json + occluded length facing the camera (taken once per viewpoint); L_m = visible length - unclear length (sum of per_path.visible_u_px); retained_share = L_m / L_f; 1 - retained_share = contribution_occlusion + contribution_unclear
